source:
@@U00643@@
Praise her to the skies! Who cares?
I'll have the last laugh, at least.
She led me on the same as she'll lead you.
Oh, I wish her a randy goblin for a sweetheart,
who'll plow her field all night where two roads cross!
I wish her a goat to bleat her a fond goodnight
with a fart on his way home from the witches’ jamboree!
A decent man of flesh and blood’s
too good for that crusty bitch.
The only greeting she'll have from me
is a brick aimed straight at her window!

@@U00645@@
(Pounding the table.)

@@U00646@@
Gentlemen! Gentlemen! Your attention!
Order in the house, if you please!
Admit, gentlemen, I’ve an inside track
on patching things up: I know what's right.
Now! Here we have a pair of lovelorn losers,
and it’s for me to send them off as friends.
All right, now, pay attention!
It’s brand new,
and join in loud as you can at the chorus.

@@U00647@@
(Sings.)

@@U00648@@
In a cellar once
There lived a rat,
A rat that ate nothing
But lard and fat.
So fat he grew
That he had a pot
As big as Doctor
Luther's got.
The cook spread poison
Around one night,
And that rat’s world
Closed in so tight,
He thought he had love in his belly.
translation:
@@U00643@@
为她点赞上天！谁在乎？
至少我会笑到最后。
她带领我就像她带领你一样。
哦，我希望她有一个好色的小妖精做情人，
谁会整晚在两条路交叉的地方耕田！
我希望她有一只山羊，给她送上一个美好的晚安
从女巫聚会回家的路上放了一个屁！
一个有血有肉的正派男人
对于那个脾气暴躁的母狗来说太好了。
她从我这里得到的唯一问候
是一块砖头直接瞄准了她的窗户！

@@U00645@@
（拍桌子。）

@@U00646@@
先生们！先生们！您的关注！
如果您愿意的话，可以在家里订购！
承认吧，先生们，我有内幕
关于修补问题：我知道什么是正确的。
现在！这里有一对失恋的失败者，
我应该以朋友的身份送走他们。
好吧，现在，注意！
这是全新的，
并尽可能大声地加入合唱团。

@@U00647@@
（唱歌。）

@@U00648@@
有一次在地窖里
那里住着一只老鼠，
一只什么也没吃的老鼠
但猪油和脂肪。
长胖了
原来他有一个锅
和医生一样大
路德得到了。
厨师散播毒药
大约一个晚上，
还有那只老鼠的世界
封闭得那么严实，
他以为他肚子里有爱。
